name: portfolio_three_sleeve
source: combination primitive from Lillo, Mazzarisi & Tsaknaki, Tackling estimation risk in Kelly investing using options
note: equal weight deliberately: the paper's point is estimation risk, and optimised weights (inverse-vol 1.347) beat naive equal weight (1.340) by less than the estimation error. Correlations: index/single +0.335, index/bear-call -0.159, single/bear-call -0.244.
